decks.name: LeetCode #567 - Permutation in String
decks.description: Check if one string contains a permutation of another string

cards.question: Permutation in String: Given two strings s1 and s2, return true if s2 contains a permutation of s1, or false otherwise. In other words, return true if one of s1's permutations is the substring of s2.

solutions.name: Sliding Window
solutions.explanation: Use a fixed-size sliding window of length s1. Compare character frequency arrays of s1 and the current window in s2. Track the number of matching frequency positions (matches). When matches equals 26, we found a permutation. Slide the window by updating frequencies and match count.

solutions.name: Hash Table
solutions.explanation: For each starting position in s2, build a hash map of character frequencies and check if it matches s1's frequencies. Track the number of characters with matching counts. Break early if we exceed s1's character count. Less efficient than sliding window but easier to understand.

solutions.name: Brute Force
solutions.explanation: Sort s1, then for each substring of s2, sort it and compare with sorted s1. If they match, we found a permutation. Very inefficient with O(n³ log n) time due to sorting every substring.
